CHUANWEI FIRE

A manufacturing source for fire-water-system components

We support trading partners, distributors and private-label customers by reviewing product configuration, marking and packaging before production.

Production follows the confirmed model and requirement.

Based in Nan'an, Quanzhou, Fujian, China, we manufacture and supply fire-water-system products and components and coordinate configuration, marking and packaging with international buyers.

Company-provided information states establishment in 2017 and 5,000 m² of production space. CNC capability supports component machining; it is not presented as proof of compliance with any specific standard or approval.
